author: reek
body: Regression guard for FabledTreasureMap entry 8: a lowercase type name under an effectful VALUE signature must parameterize like any other. Before the fix, parameterize-walk-children had no EffectfulTy arm, so the `a` in `[Console] (Maybe a)` stayed a ConstructedTy and the first use silently monomorphized the def: a second use at a different type would then mismatch. The two act-binds below force Integer and Text instantiations of the same effectful value.
